newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Sweden July c/account surplus 3.9 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sweden July c/account surplus 3.9 bln SKR.

text.p: Swedish analysts on average expect the nation's current account for July to show a surplus of 3.9 billion crowns, according to a Reuters poll of 15 economists.
In June the current account surplus was 5.2 billion crowns and in July 1995 2.5 billion crowns.
Over the 12 months to the end of June the current account balance showed a surplus of 43.6 billion crowns.
In the comparative period a year earlier there was a surplus of 20.9 billion crowns.
Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, will publish the current account balance for July on September 18 at 1000 GMT.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Chase Manhattan, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, Salomon Brothers, S-E-Banken, Swedbank, Transferator, Union Bank of Switzerland, and Unibank.
